name: Captivate Glide

images.credit: en:User:MMuzammils, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: Dual band 802.16e 2.5G (GSM/GPRS/EDGE): 850, 900, 1800, and 1900 MHz , UMTS: 850, 1900, and 2100 MHz , HSPA+: 21/42 Mbit/s; HSUPA: 5.76 Mbit/s

Body.Other: Enhanced Exchange ActiveSync (EAS) to sync email, contacts, calendar and tasks, Device and SD card encryption, Virtual private network, integrated messaging Social Hub, Readers Hub, Music Hub, and Game Hub

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.5 "Gingerbread" with TouchWiz 4.0 (upgradeable to Android 4.0.4 "Ice Cream Sandwich" officially, and unofficially upgradeable via custom ROMs to Android 4.4.4 "KitKat")
Platform.GPU: ULP GeForce, Audio DAC: Wolfson WM8994

Display.Display: 800×480 px, 10.1 cm; WVGA Super AMOLED (0.37 megapixels)

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 Mpx Back-illuminated sensor with auto focus, 720p HD video recording. Single LED flash.
Cameras.Front camera: 1.3 Mpx for video chatting, video recording (VGA), and stills

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRRS; Wi-Fi (802.11a/b/g/n); Wi-Fi Direct; Bluetooth 3.0; micro USB 2.0; MHL; HDMI; USB Host (OTG) 2.0
